findings.summary: Redundant SLA author identity checks duplicate the descriptor guard.
findings.consequence: The function is slightly harder to maintain because future changes to the exact SLA identity policy must be kept in sync between the descriptor validator and these repeated conditions.
findings.evidence: The branch first requires isSlaArticleDescriptor(value) at line 174; that guard already proves the exact SLA author and normalized author through hasExactSlaAuthor. Lines 176 and 177 then re-check the same constants. The only extra request-specific author condition needed here is value.author_id !== requestedAuthor on line 175.
findings.recommendation: Keep the request binding and article/source checks, but remove the duplicated constant checks from this unit: validate !isSlaArticleDescriptor(value), value.author_id !== requestedAuthor, value.article_id !== requestedArticle, and !descriptorLinksAreExact(value), then compare source_path to the registry path.
